title: Private Schools in Rawalpindi Face Action Over Winter Hours
excerpt: Authorities report that about 40% of private schools in the Rawalpindi district are violating official winter school timings.
body_html:
Approximately 40 percent of private schools located within the Rawalpindi district are reportedly failing to follow the winter timings established by the Punjab School Education department.

Because of these violations, authorities are moving forward with actions against the non-compliant institutions for not adhering to the mandated schedule.
